resize_tensor_with_interpolate: resize a PyTorch tensor using F.interpolate with nearest or bilinear mode and optional warnings
create_Upsample_module: create an Upsample nn.Module that upsamples tensors by a fixed scale factor or target size
upsample_with_scale_factor: upsample a tensor by a given scale factor using the Upsample module forward method
resize_with_align_corners_warning: resize a tensor with align_corners enabled and get warnings about misaligned input and output sizes
upsample_with_fixed_size: upsample a tensor to a fixed target size using the Upsample module with size parameter
